//: Release-only overlay, merged with tauri.conf.json via `tauri build --config`.
It lives in a separate file on purpose. The updater needs a PUBLIC KEY, and
that key is generated by the maintainer (`npm run tauri signer generate`) —
it does not exist yet in a fresh clone. If this block lived in the main
config, every `cargo build` and every CI run would fail on a placeholder.
The pubkey below is PUBLIC and safe to commit. The matching PRIVATE key must
never be committed — it lives only in the TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY secret.
